title: DeGift
tagline: DeGift – The AI-powered crypto gift card platform that makes sending and receiving digital assets seamless, personalized, and secure.
description:
🎁 DeGift – AI-Powered Crypto Gift Cards

DeGift is a next-generation crypto gifting platform that allows users to create, send, and redeem AI-personalized crypto gift cards effortlessly. Whether it's for birthdays, holidays, or special occasions, DeGift simplifies the process by integrating Web3 payments, smart contracts, and AI-powered recommendations.

✨ Key Features:

✅ AI-Powered Personalization – Generates thoughtful gift messages and themes.

✅ Seamless Crypto Payments – Supports multiple cryptocurrencies via Coinbase Commerce.

✅ Smart Contract Security – Ensures funds are securely locked and redeemed only by recipients.

✅ Wallet Integration – Users can connect via MetaMask, WalletConnect, or Coinbase Wallet.

✅ QR Code & Link-Based Redemption – Instant gift claiming via smart contract.

✅ User Dashboard – Track sent and received gift cards in one place.

🌟 Why It’s Unique
DeGift makes crypto gifting accessible to everyone by eliminating the complexity of on-chain transactions. The AI agent enhances the experience by suggesting personalized messages and ensuring fraud detection, while Web3 smart contracts secure fund transfers.

🚀 Say goodbye to confusing wallet addresses—just send a DeGift and let AI do the rest!
how_its_made:
🔹 How We Built DeGift
DeGift was built using a combination of Web3, AI, and modern frontend technologies to create a seamless crypto gifting experience. Our architecture consists of a Next.js frontend, a Node.js backend, and blockchain smart contracts for secure gift card issuance and redemption.

🔧 Tech Stack & Architecture

Frontend: Next.js + TailwindCSS for a smooth UI/UX experience.
Backend: Node.js + Express for API handling and transaction processing.
Database: MongoDB for tracking gift card metadata (e.g., status, sender, recipient).

Blockchain:

CDP SDK – Smart contract deployment and execution for gift cards.
AgentKit – AI-assisted transaction monitoring & fraud detection.
Web3.js / Ethers.js – Blockchain connectivity for gift card transactions.
Payments: Coinbase Commerce API for handling crypto payments securely.

AI Integration:

GPT-based AI for personalized gift messages.
Anomaly detection to flag suspicious redemption attempts.
QR Code & Link Sharing: Users receive a unique link & QR code for claiming gift cards.

🔹 How It All Works Together

Gift Card Creation – Users select a token, amount, and AI-suggested message.
Payment Processing – Users fund the gift card via Coinbase Commerce.
Smart Contract Issuance – A smart contract locks the funds until claimed.
Gift Distribution – The recipient receives a QR code & link to redeem the gift.
Redemption Process – The recipient connects a wallet & claims funds via the smart contract.
AI-Powered Features – AI suggests messages, detects anomalies, and ensures security.

💡 Hacky & Notable Things We Did

AI-Powered Gifting: Instead of just sending crypto, we used AI to generate thoughtful, personalized messages, making DeGift more meaningful.
Smart Contract-Backed Security: The funds are locked in a smart contract, preventing fraudulent claims.

No Wallet Address Required: Users send gifts via links & QR codes, making crypto gifting as easy as Venmo or PayPal.

AI Fraud Detection: We implemented pattern analysis to detect suspicious transactions, enhancing security.

By leveraging Web3, AI, and crypto payments, DeGift redefines how digital assets are gifted—making it seamless, secure, and fun! 🚀
